notes.title: Lots of bug fixes!
notes.notes:
-Fixed a bug where both the 4X and 5X (more choices) ability shows up on the current run tab if only 4X abilities are acquired. 
-Did some adjustments with UI resolution scaling for 1920x1200 monitors.
-Added an egg icon on the abilities inside the current run tab on the abilities that have been chosen by the egg.
-Fixed a weird bug where you could drag the healthbar on enemies.
-Fixed the bug where if you choose any random ability while the stopwatch is active, the stopwatch will be inactive. 
-Fixed a bug where the only 5 same abilities would show up. This was caused by having 5X abilities, not having chosen any gun abilites, and always picking the uncommon ability that appears.
-Fixed a bug where big arrows would shoot.
-Fixed a bug where the arrow storm would continue to shoot right when the danger button ending starts.
-Fixed lots of bugs related to when the player uses an auto clicker at 1ms while double tap is achieved. 
-Fixed a bug where the big heart would change position instead of spawning a new one.
-Fixed a bug where the arrow storm would shoot right after resetting the game.
-Fixed a bug where the reroll button would stay on screen while playing an ending.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.notes:
-Fixed some visual bugs related to text wrapping.

Did some points balancing changes:
-Crit clicks gets worse the more it gets upgraded
-Points needed for next level gets slightly higher after reaching 1 million+ points

notes.title: A few bug fixes
notes.notes:
-Fixed a bug where the hammer would either act weird or not hit anything if an auto clicker was being used.
-Fixed a bug where the idle button click ability would display "Endless + NaN" 
-Fixed a bug where if the player chooses any of the random abilities, the player could click on another invisible ability before the random ability pop ups where done.
-Some skull harvest stat upgrades displayed the wrong info.

Also made the skull harvest slightly stronger and I also did some small balancing changes on a few abilitites.

notes.title: QOL Improvements + Bug fixes!
notes.notes:
Added some cool stuff!

-You can now view all your current abilities acquired in your current run. You can view all the stats of each ability. This can be found inside the "Current Run" tab inside settings.
-Invinciblity changes: You now press Q once to set the invincibility on and off instead of needing to hold down Q.
-Added tooltips to all button skins and backgrounds that are unlocked.
-Re-wrote the pop up that appeart when you first reach level 75.
-Fixed some bugs and typos.

Now for the highly requested QOL improvement. You can now click the button with the left mouse click. I am still looking into key binding, but for now you can choose between spacebar and left mouse click. If you choose left mouse click, you can click the button while the cursor is anywhere on screen.
